description: This file implements map adjustment logic for the rusEfi project, including functions for initializing, adjusting, and querying map-related data, primarily used in tuning engine parameters based on AFR (Air-Fuel Ratio) measurements.

methods.name: initMapAdjuster
methods.description: Initializes the map adjustment data structures, resetting average tables and filling adjustment factors.

methods.name: adjustCell
methods.description: Adjusts a specific cell in the map based on AFR measurements and a callback to report adjustments.

methods.name: runMapAdjustments
methods.description: Iterates through all map cells and applies adjustments based on accumulated AFR data.

methods.name: addAfr
methods.description: Adds an AFR measurement to the map at a specified RPM and key position.

methods.name: getMultiplier
methods.description: Retrieves the current adjustment multiplier for a given RPM and key position.
